description: The scraper times out waiting for more .fern-changelog-card-link entries to lazy-load inside .fern-changelog-timeline before extracting. Don't wait for infinite-scroll / load-more to finish — just extract the changelog entries already rendered on initial page load.

The previous fix worked in preview but the full scraper run still times out with the same error: waiting for .fern-changelog-card-link to lazy-load in .fern-changelog-timeline. The scraper must not scroll, click load-more, or paginate at all — extract only the changelog entries present in the initial page HTML on load, nothing beyond that, even if it's just the first page of entries.
